en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 4.  It  is  narrated  that  Imam  Muhammad  Baqir  (a.s.)  said, “When a person commits fornication, he is not alone and the  Shaitaan accompanies  him. Both of them  commit this sin together. The semen is of one person only but the child belongs to both of them. Hence he is a partner of Shaitaan.”
